notes.title: The Hydra - Update 2
notes.content:
Greetings Incarnates,

We’re super excited for today’s Update, as we’ve got a new Artefact, the Soul Drain Catalyst, and a Boss, the Hydra, coming to ASCENDANTS Rising!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/3a9e42b2ac9c26e92cda9e9df892764caaa897fc.png
Soul Drain Catalyst:

The Soul Drain Catalyst is ideal for players who know how to read the battlefield as the action unfolds.

Being a channeling ability, Soul Drain boosts the damage this weapon inflicts and the mana it creates the longer this Artefact is utilized.

Soul Drain also boasts a powerful signature ability, Giga Drain, which lets you cast a mightier version of the ability for 2 seconds. If you can control this ability for its entire phase, this will result in the Artefact generating a tremendous amount of damage and mana.

The Hydra:

The Hydra bursts onto the scene, and it’s ready to annihilate you!

This Boss takes the old saying, “Two heads are better than one,” to a whole other level.

When players engage the Hydra, they will be confronted with a Boss featuring two heads. However, for each head you cut off this creature, two more heads will sprout from this Boss’s body.

It’s up to you and your fellow Incarnates to continue to engage the Hydra until it cannot spawn new heads.


 Draining Waters
Launch a bolt that deals 500 damage and applies one stack of Draining Waters to the Protector. 

Draining Waters: Deals 6000 damage over 20 seconds.

Grants the Expunge ability. Expunge"Shift+LMB": Remove 1 stacks of Draining Waters and creates a 15-meter zone that deals 300 000 damage over 300 seconds.
 Cursed Water
Creates a 6-meter area that lasts for 3 seconds. When it expires, it forms a 6-meter area that deals 240 000 damage over 120 seconds. 
 Wave
Creates a 10-meter wide Wave that sweeps the Arena, dealing 5000 damage to all Incarnates it hits.
 Coral Burst
Creates a 30-meter area that lasts for 8 seconds. When it expires, it forms a 35-meter area that deals 6000 damage.
 Eggs
Creates an Egg with 5000 health at a random location.

Egg: After 15 seconds, the Egg is destroyed, and a Commander spawns.

Eliminating the Egg deals 500 damage to all Incarnates and Bosses.
 Poison Spike
Launch a Poison Spike that deals 100 damage and applies Infection.

Infection: Increases damage taken by 25% for 60 seconds. Jumping removes all stacks of Infection and deals 500 damage to all non-Protectors.


Changelog:

Player Abilities

Kinetic Conversion: Will no longer fail to launch on random occasions.


As always, we’d like to thank all of you who continue to provide us with valuable feedback.

We hope you enjoy these new features, and we’ll see you in the Multiverse!

Group Finder

notes.title: Roadmap - Phase 1
notes.content:
Now that the Early Access version of ASCENDANTS Rising has been released, we have planned a steady stream of updates for the game.

Our current plan is to alternate between updates, which will bring new content, and patches, which will focus on bug fixes.

This week will feature our first Early Access patch; we will provide a full changelog tomorrow.
 
As we develop the new features, we will also try to share some previews as often as possible.

Please note that dates are subject to change based on feedback from players and bug fixing.

Here is the roadmap for the following 3 Updates.
Update 1 (July 8):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/8eb1db183e4d72f77ff3ccd0e900b7f2d9d18117.png
New Boss! - The Heralds
The Heralds join the battle! 

In these fights, you will be facing three different Heralds at the same time. 

Heralds come in five different flavors: Waves, Toxins, Storms, Corals, and Ice.

The first three Heralds available to fight will be the Heralds of Waves, Toxins, and Storms.

Every time you defeat a Herald, the remaining Heralds are fully healed and empowered with new abilities.
New Feature! - Group Finder
The group finder is a new feature that will allow you to search for players or groups to join.

Whenever you select a game, if your group is incomplete or you are alone, the game will offer you the possibility to list yourself on the group finder.

This will allow you to join another group or invite people to your group.
Update 2 (July 22):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/3a9e42b2ac9c26e92cda9e9df892764caaa897fc.png
New Boss! - Hydra
The Hydras come from below to end your existence.

You face two unique Hydra heads at once, but two new ones will pop out for every head you cut off. You will need to persevere until this Boss cannot generate new heads.

New Feature! - Extend Info Screen
With this feature, by holding TAB during a mission, you will be able to open two windows with additional information.

On the left, you will be able to read the current Boss's abilities and mechanics. On the right, you will be able to see a description of your abilities.

New Artefact! - Soul Drain Catalyst
The Soul Drain Catalyst is the perfect Artefact for those that know how to master the flow of a Boss battle.

Soul Drain is a channeled ability that increases the damage it deals and mana it generates the longer you have it active.

The signature ability, Giga Drain, allows you to cast a more powerful version of the ability for 2 seconds. Managing to hold it for the entire duration will yield incredible amounts of damage and mana.

Update 3 (August 5):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/350e891773c255ae6f1c911b9b8d728dfb67e4eb.png
New Feature! - Group Chat
This feature will allow you to chat with your teammates and coordinate a flawless victory or, of course, blame the hunter for pulling an extra pack of mobs.

New Boss! - The Maw
The Maw is a fleshy abomination with a massive appetite, and it's on the hunt for its next meal. We have the pleasure of letting you know you have been personally selected for its dinner.

While the Maw cannot move, it will unleash an onslaught of abilities against you, which continuously speed up.

The good news is that you can slow down its frenzy by feeding it; the bad news is that the only food available is you. 

An extra action button will allow you to jump in the Maw to appease its frenzy. Luckily for you, after years of gorging, its jaw is too bloated to close, presenting you with a convenient escape route once you are done pretending to be an appetizer.

New Ability Set! - The Alchemist Set
A new set of abilities themed around a Steampunk Asian Alchemist. 

To make the most out of these new abilities, you will have to combine different spells to trigger powerful additional effects. 

This set of abilities will reward players that like to plan and scheme their next move.

More Boss sets
Any update will potentially come with new Boss sets. However, Boss sets are not part of the roadmap, as their exact release date is too volatile.

What are Boss sets?
In the end, each Boss will have five possible variations. Their core behavior is the same. However, the ability they will use is going to be different.

These Boss variations will also slightly alter their appearances. 

The 4-Pack
We will also create a new 4-Pack in the store, allowing you to purchase four copies of the game with a 40% price discount.

A big thank you to everyone who supports us while we develop ASCENDANTS Rising in Early Access.

See you in the Multiverse!

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.content:
Greetings Incarnates,

Today the Early Access goes live!

The game is now available to purchase for people who want to support us and participate in the game’s development.

Why release an Early Access so early in the game development?

From experience, as players and developers, we have learned that it is not possible to polish a game without input from many players. So our ambition is to have as many players as possible provide us with feedback.

The reality of game development is that once you are 3 - 4 months away from release, it is almost impossible to change the game.

That is why we choose to start the Early Access almost a year before the actual release. To make sure we can not only listen to feedback but also change the game for the better.

How often can we expect updates and new content?

Our goal is to have many small updates. Giving an exact schedule for those updates will be complicated.
However, we aim to have an average of 2 updates per month. That is excluding hotfixes, of course.

What can we expect from those updates?

The first update will probably be a bug-fix patch. After that, our priority will be to implement new Bosses, new weapons, new spells, and new character creation options.

We are also in parallel preparing the next Dungeon game mode.

How can we have our feedback heard?

We will mainly be using 2 platforms for feedback.

The first one is the Steam forums, if you have any feedback or suggestions you would like to share with us, you can create a post there.

We also have our Discord; if you any questions or you want to discuss the game with others, you are welcome to join: https://discord.gg/2uNp4th

The discord is also here so you can search for other people to play with.


We hope that everyone will enjoy ASCENDANTS Rising and that together, we can create an amazing game.

notes.title: Closed Beta - Update 2
notes.content:
Greetings Incarnates,

This week in the Multiverse, you will be able to find two new Bosses, a new Artefact, Legendaries Outfits, and more!

Before going into more details about the update, note that you can find a small Press Pack here: LINK

New Content:

New Artefact - Energy Axe and Shield
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/e516ef982b11c9653941a7a6120e0c0a70de7685.png
The Energy Axe and Shield are now available to test. This Artefact is ideal for fights where you frequently take damage:

Axe Swing
Deals 500 damage to enemies in front of you.

Generates 5 mana if an enemy is hit.
Shield Burst
Deals 1000 damage in the shape of a cone in front of you and consumes any Revenge stack you have, dealing 50 additional damage per stack. 

Passive: Taking damage grants a stack of Revenge. You can have up to 20 stack. 

Generates 15 mana if a target is hit.

The Inquisitor
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/1f707e1c13383f7657836a84c3da369418f3a1c2.png
Making his debuts in the Coliseum, we have the Inquisitor.

This fight is split into two alternating phases: 


Main Phase: During this phase you directly fights the Inquisitor. He will have the following abilities:

Curse of Servitude
Every basic attack will apply Curse of Servitude.

Curse of Servitude: Increases damage taken by 4% and grants the Submit ability.

Submit ("Shift+LMB"): Remove all Curses of Servitude and deals 1000 damage to all Incarnates.
Poison Spike
Launch a Poison Spike that deals 100 damage and applies Infection.

Infection: Increases taken by 25% for 60 seconds. Jumping 
removes all stacks of Infection and deals 500 damage to all Incarnates.
Acid Rain
Creates a 4-meter area for 3 seconds at all Incarnates' locations. When it expires, it deals 3000 damage to all Incarnates standing in the area.

 Egg Phase:  At two different Health Threshold, the Inquisitor will hide inside a giant Egg to evolve himself.

The Incarnates will have to destroy the Egg as fast as possible. Every second he spends inside increases the damage he deals for the reminder of the fights.

Which each new Egg he will gain new abilities:

 Poison Bomb (Egg Phase 1):  
Creates a Poison Orb with 5000 health that lasts for 25 seconds.

Every 8 seconds, the Poison Orb deals 3000 damage to all Incarnates.
 Coral Burst(Egg Phase 2):  
Creates a 30-meter area that lasts for 8 seconds. When it expires, it creates an 30-meter area that deals 6000 damage.


Cetus and Levias
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/db030d9365627fd6a64b7d61ff80cb0997f514db.png
While Levias starts alone on the platforms, he will quickly call Cetus for Help.

You will have to deal with those two threats simultaneously, and killing one before the other will make them Enrage.

Each of them has different set of Abilities:

Levias

Acid Bomb
Launch a bolt that deals 500 damage and apply an Acid Bomb to the Protector.

Acid Bomb: Lasts for 8 seconds; when it expires, it deals 16 000 damage split between all Incarnates within 5 meters.
Bubbling Acid
Launch a projectile that applies Bubbling Acid to a random non-Protector Incarnate. 

Bubbling Acid: Deals 500 damage over 10 seconds. If it deals damage while you're moving, it also deals 500 damage to all Incarnates.

Cetus

Eggs
Creates an Egg with 5000 health at a random location.

Egg: After 15 seconds, the Egg is destroyed, and a Commander is spawned.

Destroying the Egg deals 500 damage to all Incarnates and the Bosses.
Wave
Create a 10-meter wide Wave that sweeps the Arena, dealing 5000 damage to all Incarnates it hits.



Outfits and Legendary Variants 
In Ascendants Rising, Players will be able to customize their characters with outfits.

Most Outfits will be unlocked through progression or achievements. Your first unlocks will be the Incarnate Officers Set:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/4f9112b4f0100e1fddbfdf61018e23d95d976db1.png
Each outfit's sets will have a Legendary variant. Legendaries are usually earned through challenges inside the game.

However, the first set is a gift from us for anyone that participates in the Early Access.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/9556ecc625d718d97e7c027f25e852fee2053e83.png
Here is also a sneak peak as to what the next set will look like:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/d5f031b7076c418bf835f70d3906d0f61c02ef52.png
Changelog:

Player Abilities

 New Artefact: Axe and Shield.

 Soul Mass: Will now correctly generate orbs.
 Dash n Slash: Will no longer improperly hit the target twice.
 Revolver Shot: Fixed an issue that sometimes stopped it from firing.

 Visual Effects: An overall pass has been made to improve readability during combat.

Coliseum

New Boss!:  The InquisItor
New Boss!:  Levias and Cetus
General: Bosses should now spawn faster.
Frost Golem: Will now spawn properly on the ground.

Tutorial

notes.title: Closed Beta - Update 1
notes.content:
Greetings Incarnates, 

We are very excited to release this first update for the Closed Beta, and we want to thank everybody who took the time to provide us with feedback.

With this update, we want to shift the testing focus to the Coliseum.

With this update, you will find:

The Coliseum:

In the Coliseum, Incarnates fight to prove themselves worthy.

This is a 4 Player Game Mode where you will be facing a series of 3 randomized Bosses.

You will need to assemble a team including 1 Protector, 1 Healer, and 2 Strikers to prevail.

To access the Coliseum, a new temporary “Sessions” Test Menu has been made available. From there, you can create a Coliseum test server for 4 players.

Note that the test servers will only start once 4 players have joined.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/7c7471df70c0b0174a221787aac9329440de2153.png

Frost Golem

For this first testing session, your only adversary will be the Frost Golem.

As we move forward, in the next update, we will add new Bosses and swap which enemies are available for testing in the Coliseum.

The Frost Golem is your run-of-the-mill starting Boss. It is meant to be simple to understand while offering a substantial challenge.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/353d7f271501a1a448fc5d2f8e86639bf2ba35d2.png

Frost Golem Abilities:

Weakening Ritual
Creates an 3 meter zone for 3 seconds at the tank's location. When the zone expires, it deals 2500 damage to the player in it and applies Weakness.

If there are no players located in this zone, it deals 3000 damage to all players.

Weakness: Increase damage taken by 50% for 30 Seconds.
Cursed Water
Launch a projectile that applies Cursed Waters.

Cursed Waters: Last for 6 seconds; when it expires, it creates an 8 meter area at the location for 3 seconds.

When that zone expires, it creates an 8 meter area that deals 240 000 damage over 120 seconds.
Wave
Create an 10 meter wide Wave that sweeps the Arena, dealing 5000 damage  to players it impacts.
Toxic Corals
Creates an 8 meter area that lasts for 3 seconds. When it expires, it creates an 8 meter area that deals 240 000 damage over 120 seconds.
Snowstorm 
An arena wide area that deals 100 damage every 3 seconds. 

If there are no allies within 4 meters of you, you take additional 100 damage.


To emerge victorious against the Frost Golem, your team’s placement will be key.

Bug Fixes and Improvements

 Players will no longer be obligated to link their Steam account to an Epic account.
 Steam VR should no longer launch when trying to play the game.
 Advanced Tutorial enemy damage lowered to appropriate levels.

Providing Feedback:


If after slaying the Frost Golem you have time to provide some feedback, here are a few questions that we would be grateful if you could answer:

What did you think about the Coliseum environment?
How did you feel your role impacted the fight (Protector, Striker, or Healer)?
Were there some Enemy Abilities that were hard to understand or read?
How fast did you kill the Boss, and how did you feel about the length of the fights?

As usual, the Steam Forums are the place for you to submit feedback, but you are also welcome to share your thoughts with us on our Discord: https://discord.gg/2uNp4th

Thank you, and see you in the Multiverse!

notes.title: Closed Beta Opening
notes.content:
Our ambition with Early Access is to develop the game with direct feedback from a community of players.
This will come in several phases with a large number of small updates and patches.

Phase 1: Ability Testing (Closed Beta)

Phase 1 is a pre-release Closed Beta that will last 10 days. Players will gain access via invitation or by giveaways on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/2uNp4th

Our Testing Goals for this first phase are:


The Character Creation


This will give a small sample of how the character creation will work in the game. Over the course of our game’s development, we will add more options.

The Player Ability System


At the core of the game is how players build and customize their playstyle. In this first phase, we have unlocked all the Spells and Artefacts.

We want to see what players can do with the system and how it can be improved.
Pressing the “Play” button will grant access to a training room where you will find enemies to test different builds and setups against.

Where to send feedback:

Our goal is to have direct interaction with the feedback you provide us; to that effect, we will be using the Steam forum.

Phase 2!

Phase two will start after the Closed Beta ends and will be the Early Access release.
We will provide more information as we get closer to the date.
